title: A closing fork must not write receipts: the owning session writes them (candidate; cost unmeasured)
why: Guard queued per rule building-mistake-names-its-guard (queued as step:writer-never-writes-receipts). Mistake: triage's close forks wrote the receipts doc themselves on six items closed since 20:00 CST Nov 14: 849 (pick-carry-clean-merge-replacement), 851 (pick-records-page-clean-merge-tree), 852 (pick-debt-step-skip-guard-rerun), 328 (qmax-d369-error-source), 861 (pick-standing-sessions-tiny-fixes), 865 (pick-3381-accept-checks-loss). Rule: skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md line 195 'receipts/<id>: written by the owning session, never by the page'; lines 286-288 'The writer never writes receipts'; Route and close step 1 (lines ~467-469): the owning session writes read, then filed. Read-only check (ArtifactData, 02:43 CST): all six receipts carry a read and filed time equal or within seconds of the close time (for 849, 852, 328, 861 read equals filed; 865 read 07:44:20Z, filed 07:44:50Z); the owner field on each names the coordinator, the consultant or a lane, never triage. So each receipt looks writer-written. Harm: a false 'read' time on the page, because the owning session never read or filed at that time. Older closes were not checked. Guard idea: the brief for a closing fork says 'the owning session writes the receipt; do not write receipts', and the page writer's close script or the fork brief template refuses a receipts/<id> write by the writer. Cost: unmeasured (one line in each close brief). The fix to triage's own brief applies from now: every closing fork brief says 'the owner session writes the receipt; do not write receipts'. Open: whether a writer-written receipt on a chat answer is acceptable (the skill says no; a consultant or owner ruling could allow it). Nothing was changed on the page: read-only check. 02:44 CST Nov 15, consultant ruled (b) (consultant's pick under the owner's 20:18 words, not owner-typed): for a chat-relayed answer the relaying session is the reader; receipts 861 and 865 rewritten by triage: 861 read 06:50:00Z (consultant 00:50 CST, relayed 00:55), filed 06:51:35Z (ruling own-tiny-fixes-b commit a1e68333d; was 06:51:13Z/06:51:13Z); 865 read 07:43:00Z (01:43 CST), filed 07:45:29Z (ruling own-3381-a commit 1e42c62b6; was 07:44:20Z/07:44:50Z); each carries a writtenBy field 'written by triage for the consultant's chat read' (a new field: the receipts doc had only read and filed). Read back at version 2. 849, 851, 852, 328 not rewritten (consultant named only 861 and 865). The skill sentence (SKILL.md lines 195, 286-288) is still to amend to name the chat-relayed case; no lane yet.
source: Triage, 02:43 CST Nov 15, after the fork that closed item 865 reported writing its receipt and the skill text said the writer never does.
note: Candidate guard; not built; owner coordinator. Six receipts looked writer-written (849 851 852 328 861 865); none rewritten.
